doc.title: Pete Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999

title: Esquire new star award and Rex Stewart
summary: Pete remembers who voted for him for the Esquire award and praises Rex Stewart.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: You got the Esquire award — new star in 1946. That’s nice.
Yeah. Who voted it for me, God I forgot the band leader. I’ll tell you who voted for me, “Boy Meets Horn.”
“Boy Meets Horn” with Duke Ellington. Rex.

Rex Stewart, oh God bless him. What a wonderful musician he was. You know, that composition on “Boy Meets Horn.” We had a lot of other things he had written, just a marvelous musician, and of course one of a kind I think.
